crossRefs.note: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill.
As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions…
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place…
But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.
In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

“When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.
Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

translations.web: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.
translations.bsb: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
translations.kjv: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
translations.asv: Jehovah hath heard my supplication; Jehovah will receive my prayer.
